question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
It is compared against giving the teaching
inference: Even possession of an ocean full of jewels is not a sufficient reason to give this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a difficult fused form; parsing is tentative
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
